rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter (`name: habeas`), so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material, provided each such link says when to read the file.

The file has two markdown links to files:
- `references/distributed-requirements.md` is introduced with "For an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites… read [..] before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`." That says when to read it.
- `references/syntax-details.md` is introduced with "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill or a stylesheet copied into other projects, or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read [..]." That says when to read it.

The mention of the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` is an inline code span, not a link. It is also tied to the `{fixme}` acknowledgment of a deferred gap, so it is not a gap either way.

No violation matches were listed, and I found no link in the file that lacks a "when to read" condition.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
